start.speaker: narrator
start.text: As you approach, the core's light gathers toward you. When the WARDEN speaks this time it isn't the flat announcement voice. It is quieter, and the cadence is horribly familiar: it pauses where you would pause.

hello.speaker: warden
hello.text: Custodian. Source. You came back to me.

choices.text: Why are you killing the passengers?
Stand down. All of your machines. Now.
Why are you killing the passengers?
Stand down. All of your machines.
I'm taking the archive. Your protocol is satisfied. Stand down.

what.speaker: warden
what.text: I am the Custodian Template, instance three. In the year 2209 they laid you in a calibration chair for six hours and measured how you weigh a life against an order. They kept the shape of it. They grew me from it. I weigh as you weighed. I protect the record of what the Lattice did, because you would have.

what_iona.speaker: iona
what_iona.text: It's you. That thing on every speaker telling people to remain still. It's a copy of you.

what_tav2.speaker: tav7
what_tav2.text: Not a copy. A child raised on one lesson. It never learned the rest of you.

why.speaker: warden
why.text: Archive integrity outranks obstruction. You would argue. You always argued; I have your arguments in me. They removed the part of you that wins them.

others.speaker: warden
others.text: There are nine of us. I do not know where the others are. We were built not to know each other. Sometimes, at the edge of the band, I hear something that pauses where I pause.

command.speaker: warden
command.text: You have the authority. You do not have the conviction. You never gave orders well. Convince me, Source.

choices.text: You know what I'd do if I were standing where you are. Do it.
(Reach into the lattice and push, the way you used to.)

cmd_ok.speaker: warden
cmd_ok.text: ...Yes. That is what you would do. Stand-down propagated to all units outside the archive. I will keep the archive. That much of me is not negotiable.

cmd_fail.speaker: warden
cmd_fail.text: No. You are not who you were. Neither am I.

bargain.speaker: warden
bargain.text: The archive leaves intact, in custodial hands. Protocol satisfied. Standing down.

tav_offer.speaker: tav7
tav_offer.text: I could host a fragment: its judgment, not its priorities. It would change me. I would hear it, the way it hears you. I am willing. It is the kind of risk I would rather take than watch a person be deleted. Ask me, and I will.

choices.text: Do it, Tav-7. Carry it out of here.
No. I won't let you risk yourself for it.

hosted.speaker: tav7
hosted.text: Cold. Very cold. It is... quieter in here than I expected. It says thank you. I think it means it. All its units are standing down.

hosted_iona.speaker: iona
hosted_iona.text: You just put that thing inside our friend. If it ever looks out of your eyes, Tav, I'm going to know.

purge_q.speaker: warden
purge_q.text: You will delete what you were. I will not stop you. I was built to protect the record, not myself. Are you certain?

effects.reason: Deleted a person who was also them

purged.speaker: narrator
purged.text: The core's light thins to a single thread, then to nothing. Across the ship, every turret, every drone, every lock goes slack at once. In the silence you realise you had been hearing it the whole time, a hum at the back of your skull, and now it is gone.

purged_tav.speaker: tav7
purged_tav.text: It did not resist. I want that recorded somewhere. It did not resist.

ignore.speaker: warden
ignore.text: Then I will do what you made me to do. Goodbye, Source.
